name: echo-coding-semantic-governance
description: 面向 Codex、Cursor 和 Claude Code 的项目无关语义治理插件

scripts.format:check: npx --yes prettier@3.6.2 --check '.agents/**/*.json' '.claude-plugin/**/*.json' '.codex-plugin/**/*.json' '.cursor-plugin/**/*.json' '.github/**/*.yml' 'hooks/**/*.{json,mjs}' 'runtime/**/*.json' 'runtime/**/*.mjs' 'bin/**/*.mjs' 'scripts/**/*.mjs' 'tests/**/*.mjs' action.yml package.json && uvx ruff==0.16.6 format --check scripts/governance_contract.py skills/semantic-contract/scripts/verify_semantic.py skills/semantic-preflight/scripts/preflight.py skills/semantic-status/scripts/status.py tests/test_preflight.py && uvx ruff==0.16.6 check scripts/governance_contract.py skills/semantic-contract/scripts/verify_semantic.py skills/semantic-preflight/scripts/preflight.py skills/semantic-status/scripts/status.py tests/test_preflight.py
scripts.test: node scripts/validate-plugin.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm test && uv run skills/semantic-contract/scripts/verify_semantic.py --self-test && uv run skills/semantic-contract/scripts/verify_semantic.py --root . --strict-snapshot
